name: print-social-natural-product-flyer-on-wood-mockup
title: Onion oil hair-care flyer mocked up on light wood
whatItIs: An A5-style flyer mockup on pale wood with hard shadows. It shows a bottle and box, coconuts and onions, a bold black product name, ingredient callouts and a dark green footer with a phone number.
whatItMeans: Clean, trustworthy and organic; natural ingredients and plain typography say 'simple and effective'.
techniques: Place real ingredients around the packshot to explain the formula visually.
Use a white panel with a dark green footer to hold contact info.
Set the product name in very heavy black caps as the hook.
Photograph on light wood with a hard diagonal shadow for a crafted feel.

vocabulary.definition: A clean image of a product and its packaging.
A short label highlighting one component of a product.
A solid strip along the bottom for contact info.
A photo setting lit with strong sunlight shadows.
